text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown. Neo Universe is 
reunited with a Trainer with whom she 
never ended up signing a contract in the 
past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing in the way is the Umamusume 
trained by someone she once parted ways 
with. The fated showdown begins now!
